exposure: place of delivery (public, employment based, private, or out of facility)
outcome: receipt of immediate postpartum contraception prior to discharge
cohort: The study included a nationally representative sample of 7022 women aged 12-39 years old at their last delivery in Mexico.
finding: Age was not significantly associated with receipt of postpartum contraception, but women delivering in public facilities had lower odds of receiving a method compared with those in employment-based insurance facilities.
